title: Insurance Coverage Denial Letter – Acme Indemnity
text:
Acme Indemnity Company
4500 Commerce Street
Houston, Texas 77002

Certified Mail Return Receipt Requested

Date: June 15, 2024

To: Marcus T. Ellison
2304 Cypress Creek Lane
Spring, Texas 77379

Re: Claim No. AIC-2024-0456-LL
Policy No. HP-889233-01

Dear Mr. Ellison:

This letter is to inform you that Acme Indemnity Company (“Acme”) has completed its investigation of the claim you submitted under your homeowner’s policy, and we must deny coverage for the loss described in your claim dated March 22, 2024. The denial is based on the policy’s exclusion for water damage caused by earth movement, as set forth in Section 3.2(b) of your policy.

Our investigation, conducted by our senior claims adjuster, Patricia R. Nguyen, revealed that the damage to your foundation and interior walls was caused by subsidence of the soil beneath your residence. The Texas Department of Insurance has consistently held that such earth movement is not a covered peril under standard homeowner policies unless a specific endorsement provides coverage. Your policy does not contain such an endorsement.

You have the right to appeal this decision under the Texas Insurance Code § 542.051, which governs the handling of claims. You may also request mediation through the Texas Department of Insurance.

Please be advised that this denial is a final decision, subject only to the appeal rights outlined above. Should you wish to pursue legal action, you must do so within the time allowed by law, and we have provided the relevant information below.

We have assigned this claim to our in-house counsel, Samuel J. Whitaker, who can answer any questions you may have. He can be reached at (713) 555-0198 or by email at s.whitaker@acmeindemnity.com.

For your records, the cause number for any legal action you may file is CC-2024-0789, pending in Harris County. The docket number for our internal appeal is AP-2023-2176.

We also note that you have previously been known as Marcus T. Ellison, formerly known as Marcus T. Ellison (maiden name of your mother, Ellen R. Ellison, who was named on the original policy).

Your date of birth, as provided in your application, is March 14, 1971, which we have verified.

We have enclosed a copy of the policy and the relevant endorsement schedule. If you have any questions, please contact our claims department at (713) 555-0147 or via email at claims@acmeindemnity.com.

Sincerely,

Linda G. Pemberton
Claims Manager
Acme Indemnity Company

Enclosures: Policy, Endorsement Schedule, Investigation Report

cc: Samuel J. Whitaker, Esq.

Please note that any legal notices must be sent to our registered agent, Corporate Creations Network Inc., at 100 Main Street, Houston, Texas 77001.

We trust this clarifies our position.

This letter is not intended to be a waiver of any policy defense.

For legal purposes, the policy is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

We reserve all rights.

If you have any questions, please call our office.

Thank you.

Acme Indemnity Company

title: Denial of Underinsured Motorist Coverage
text:
Gulf Coast Mutual Insurance Company
1200 Bayou Drive
Houston, Texas 77005

Certified Mail

June 28, 2024

RE: Claim of Jordan A. Mitchell
Policy No. 104-77-8823
Claim No. 77-33021

Dear Ms. Mitchell:

We are writing to deny your claim for underinsured motorist benefits under the above-referenced policy. Our investigation into the accident of April 12, 2024 has concluded that the tortfeasor, Bruce D. Kowalski, had liability limits that exceed the amount of your claimed damages, and therefore the underinsured motorist coverage is not triggered.

As part of our investigation, we obtained the police report and medical records. We also conducted an examination under oath on June 3, 2024, at which you testified that you have fully recovered from your injuries. Your treating physician, Dr. Alan H. Rodriguez, has released you to full duty. Based on this evidence, we find that the damages you claim are not supported by the medical evidence.

Your policy, Section C, states that underinsured motorist coverage applies only if the limits of all bodily injury liability bonds and policies applicable at the time of the accident are less than the amount of damages you are legally entitled to recover. Because Mr. Kowalski’s policy provided $100,000 per person, and our evaluation of your claim places your economic and non-economic damages at $45,000, the tortfeasor’s limits are not less than your damages. Therefore, coverage is denied.

You have the right to request arbitration as provided in the policy. To do so, you must submit a written request within 30 days to our arbitration administrator, Janet L. Witherspoon, at the address above.

We have retained the services of the law firm of Brown & Okafor, LLP, to represent us in any legal proceedings. Our counsel, Rachel T. Brown, may be contacted at (713) 555-0172 or r.brown@brownokafor.com.

For your information, the accident occurred at the intersection of 610 Loop and Westheimer Road in Houston, Texas. The case number assigned to any lawsuit you may file will be 2024-55674, in the 190th Judicial District Court of Harris County. The docket number for our file is D-2024-1188.

Your date of birth is October 3, 1965, as stated in your application.

Please note that this denial is based on the policy language and Texas law. Texas Insurance Code § 1952.102 provides for the offer of underinsured motorist coverage, but we have complied with all statutory requirements.

We also refer you to the case of In re State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company, 110 S.W.3d 212 (Tex. App.—Houston [1st Dist.] 2003), which supports our position.

Any questions may be directed to our claims department at (713) 555-0115.

We regret the necessity of this denial.

Sincerely,

Harold J. Simmons
Senior Claims Supervisor
Gulf Coast Mutual Insurance Company

Enclosures: Policy, Medical Report, Police Report

cc: Rachel T. Brown, Esq.

This letter is in lieu of a formal denial letter.

We reserve all rights.

Your policy number is 104-77-8823.

Please be advised that the policy was issued to you in your former name of Jordan A. Mitchell, formerly known as Jordan A. Miller.

We have also noted that your minor child, A.B., is not a named insured and has no coverage under this policy.

Please be advised that the court in In re National Lloyds Insurance Company, 155 S.W.3d 621 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2005) held that an insurer may deny coverage without bad faith.

This letter constitutes final denial.

We look forward to your response.

title: Denial of Long-Term Care Insurance Claim
text:
Lone Star Life & Health Assurance
8899 Medical Center Drive
Houston, Texas 77030

Certified Mail

July 10, 2024

To: Edith V. Harrington
5520 Oakmont Avenue
Houston, Texas 77056

Policy Number: LTC-77201
Claim Number: 2024-3345

Dear Ms. Harrington:

We have reviewed your claim for long-term care benefits submitted on May 15, 2024. Unfortunately, we must deny coverage because the services you received were not deemed medically necessary by our independent medical reviewer, Dr. Mark A. Sorenson.

Our policy, which is governed by Texas Insurance Code § 1704.001, provides coverage for skilled nursing care only when it is ordered by a physician and is medically necessary. In your case, your attending physician, Dr. Emily R. Chen, prescribed custodial care, which is not covered under your policy. Custodial care is defined as care that is primarily for the purpose of assisting with activities of daily living and does not require the skills of a licensed nurse.

We have also obtained the opinion of Dr. Sorenson, who concluded that you do not require skilled nursing care. His report is enclosed.

You have the right to appeal this determination within 60 days. If you appeal, we will have your case reviewed by an independent review organization. To initiate an appeal, please contact our appeals coordinator, Paul G. Thomson, at (713) 555-0123 or via email at p.thomson@lonestarhealth.com.

This denial also applies to any claim for adult day care services. We note that you have a minor in your care, referred to as A.B., but that is not relevant to this claim.

Please be advised that your policy was originally issued to you under your maiden name, Edith V. Olson. Your current name is Edith V. Harrington, formerly known as Edith V. Olson.

For your information, the case number assigned to any lawsuit arising from this denial is cause number CV-2024-0987 in the 215th Judicial District Court of Harris County. The docket number for our internal file is A-2024-5678.

Your date of birth is March 14, 1971, as per our records.

We also refer you to the case of In re Continental Casualty Company, 302 S.W.3d 510 (Tex. App.—Austin 2009), which addresses the standard of review for such denials.

If you have any questions, please contact our legal department at (713) 555-0167.

Sincerely,

Michael R. Delgado
Claims Director
Lone Star Life & Health Assurance

Enclosures: Medical Necessity Report, Policy Excerpts

cc: Paul G. Thomson

This letter is a final denial.

You may also contact the Texas Department of Insurance.

We reserve the right to assert all defenses.

We appreciate your understanding.

Our address is 8899 Medical Center Drive, Houston, Texas 77030.

We have enclosed a copy of the policy.

Thank you.

title: Denial of Life Insurance Claim Due to Misrepresentation
text:
Capitol Hill Assurance Group
4500 Congress Avenue
Austin, Texas 78701

Certified Mail

August 5, 2024

To: Estate of Harold B. Patterson
c/o Executor, Margaret L. Patterson
1010 Red River Street
Austin, Texas 78701

Policy No. 51-780-3390
Claim No. 2024-8890

Dear Ms. Patterson:

Capitol Hill Assurance Group (“CHAG”) has completed its investigation into the claim filed on behalf of the estate of Harold B. Patterson. We regret to inform you that we are denying coverage due to material misrepresentations made by the insured on the application for life insurance.

Specifically, on the application dated September 15, 2022, Mr. Patterson answered “No” to the question of whether he had been diagnosed with a heart condition. However, medical records from Dr. Susan T. Kim indicate that on August 12, 2022, Mr. Patterson was diagnosed with cardiomyopathy. This misrepresentation is material because it directly affected our decision to issue the policy and the premium charged.

Under Texas Insurance Code § 705.003, a misrepresentation in an application for insurance may be grounds for voiding the policy if it is material and relied upon by the insurer. We have relied on the answers provided, and we would have declined coverage had we known of his condition.

We have enclosed the medical records and the application for your review.

You have the right to appeal this decision. To do so, please contact our legal department within 30 days. Our counsel, Laura B. Whitfield, Esq., can be reached at (512) 555-0144 or l.whitfield@chag.com.

For your information, the cause number assigned to any legal action is CA-2024-1122 in Travis County. The docket number is 2024-00678.

The policy was issued to Mr. Patterson who was born on March 14, 1971, and his date of birth is on our records.

We note that the policy was issued in the name of Harold B. Patterson, formerly known as Harold B. Patterson, but using his maiden name? We clarify that his mother’s maiden name was Helen R. Patterson, but that is not relevant.

Your claim includes a minor child, A.B., who is not a beneficiary under the policy. The sole beneficiary is Margaret L. Patterson.

We also refer you to the case of In re American National Insurance Company, 456 S.W.3d 789 (Tex. App.—San Antonio 2015), which supports our position.

Please direct all correspondence to our claims department at the address above or via email at claims@chag.com.

We also have a street address: 4500 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701.

If you have any questions, call us at (512) 555-0189.

Sincerely,

Robert J. O'Malley
Senior Claims Officer
Capitol Hill Assurance Group

Enclosures: Application, Medical Records

cc: Laura B. Whitfield, Esq.

This is a final denial.

We reserve all rights.

Thank you.

title: Denial of Homeowners Claim for Flood Damage
text:
Bayou City Property & Casualty
7777 Katy Freeway
Houston, Texas 77024

Certified Mail

September 1, 2024

To: Robert T. Lindquist
1200 Westheimer Road, Apt 5B
Houston, Texas 77006

Policy No. H-441-7789
Claim No. 2024-2290

Dear Mr. Lindquist:

This letter acknowledges receipt of your claim for damage to your residence caused by flooding on May 10, 2024. After a thorough investigation, Bayou City Property & Casualty (“BCPC”) has determined that your policy excludes coverage for flood damage. We regret to inform you that your claim is denied.

Your policy, under Section I – Perils Excluded, states that “water damage from flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, or overflow of a body of water” is not covered. Our adjuster, David M. Hernandez, confirmed that the water intrusion originated from the overflowing of Buffalo Bayou, which is a flood event. Therefore, the loss is excluded.

We note that you have a federal flood insurance policy through the National Flood Insurance Program, which may provide coverage. That policy is separate and not affected by this denial.

You have the right to appeal this decision under Texas Insurance Code § 541.060. If you choose to appeal, you must submit a written request within 30 days to our appeals department. You may contact our appeals officer, Katherine J. Adams, at (713) 555-0156 or by email at k.adams@bcpc.com.

For your records, the cause number for any legal action is 2024-33456, in Harris County. The docket number for our internal file is D-2024-7788.

We also remind you that your policy is in the name of Robert T. Lindquist, formerly known as Robert T. Lindquist (no change), but we have on file your date of birth as March 14, 1971.

We have also identified that your minor child, A.B., is not a party to this claim.

We refer you to the case of In re Allstate Insurance Company, 234 S.W.3d 112 (Tex. App.—Houston [14th Dist.] 2007), which holds that flood exclusions are enforceable.

If you have any questions, please contact our claims department at (713) 555-0132 or via email at claims@bcpc.com.

Our office is located at 7777 Katy Freeway, Houston, Texas 77024.

Sincerely,

Patricia A. Nguyen (please note this is a different Patricia than in prior letters)
Claims Manager
Bayou City Property & Casualty

Enclosures: Policy Excerpt, Flood Zone Map

cc: Katherine J. Adams

This is a final denial.

We reserve all rights.

Please be advised that we have also been served with a subpoena for your SSN, which is 456-78-9123, but we have not released it.

We have included your SSN for verification purposes: 456 78 9123.

Thank you.
